basicFilteringModeDescription.message:
Shaandhayn shabakadeed oo aasaasi ah oo ka timid liisaska shaandhada ee la doortay.

Uma baahna ogolaansho si loo akhriyo oo loo beddelo xogta websaydhyada.

optimalFilteringModeDescription.message:
Shaandhayn shabakadeed oo horumarsan oo ay weheliso shaandhayn gaar ah oo la fidiyay oo ka timid liisaska shaandhada ee la doortay.

Waxay u baahan tahay ogolaansho ballaaran si loo akhriyo oo loo beddelo xogta websaydhyada oo dhan.

completeFilteringModeDescription.message:
Shaandhayn shabakadeed oo horumarsan oo ay weheliso shaandhayn gaar ah iyo mid guud oo la fidiyay oo ka timid liisaska shaandhada ee la doortay.

Waxay u baahan tahay ogolaansho ballaaran si loo akhriyo oo loo beddelo xogta websaydhyada oo dhan.

Shaandhaynta la fidiyay ee guud waxay sababi kartaa isticmaalka kheyraadka bogga websaydhka oo kordha.
